title: PPL Stock Surges 6.3%, With A 11-Day Winning Spree - Trefis
summary: PPL Stock Surges 6.3%, With A 11-Day Winning Spree Trefis
body:
PPL (PPL) – a provider of electricity and natural gas services in Kentucky – hit a 11-day winning streak, with cumulative gains over this period amounting to 6.3%. The company’s market cap has surged by about $1.7 Bil over the last 11 days and currently stands at $29 Bil.

Is this an opportunity or a trap? There are a few things to fear in PPL stock given its overall Moderate operating performance and financial condition. Hence, despite its Moderate valuation, this makes the stock look Risky (For details, see Buy or Sell PPL).
